q1_issues.issue: The additive focus particle "also" is dropped — the licensed opaque (Also <filler> <event>) tag is never emitted.
The complement "in green" is dropped entirely, so the parse asserts bare availability and loses the colour the shirt is available in.

q2_gaps: focus particle ("also") over a purely copular clause — (<Op> <filler> <event>) presupposes an event witness, and a copular clause has none unless a separate state-reification trigger fires
notes: The two emitted atoms are individually correct (demonstrative singular -> typed witness, flat copular property). The adjective's PP-complement rule would have supplied the reified state that both "in green" and the focus tag could have anchored on.
